analogy.rationale: Inhibiting DNA-directed DNA polymerase blocks DNA replication, producing a DNA-damage/replication-stress transcriptional program similar to other DNA synthesis and DNA-damaging agents; topoisomerase and ribonucleotide reductase inhibitors converge on the same replication-stress response, while alkylating agents share downstream DNA damage signaling.
